summary: Iteration 22 end-to-end verification for Rox Taxi guest-approve → Facebook post → gallery-live flow, plus new repost endpoint and Pillow 1200x630 auto-crop. 22/22 backend tests pass (10 new + 12 gallery regression). Frontend GalleryPanel two-tab UI works: Pending tab, Approved tab with FB status badges (posted/failed/not-attempted) and per-item repost button + view-live-post link. Facebook remains scope-blocked as expected (pages_manage_posts missing on token) — assertions treat that as the current state and validate the non-Facebook contract. Regressions verified for /driver/manifest (data renders) and PackagesStrip testids on home. PushToggle only renders inside AdminDashboard (by design).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 2086 lines — well over 700-line threshold; consider splitting into resource modules (gallery, bookings, push, etc.).
facebook.py fbPostUrl in GalleryPanel splits on '_' but Facebook post IDs use format 'pageid_postid'. Current logic is a best-effort; verify once a real post_id lands.

In server.py approve handler (~L1080), the DB write for facebook fields is inside try/except but if the update itself raises (e.g. Mongo hiccup), fb_result is overwritten with 'exception:' outside the outer post call scope — flow still returns approved, which is safe, but the DB update is not retried.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 approved test submission via end-to-end flow (TEST_Iter22Guest, TEST_iter22_e2e caption). Left approved for admin panel inspection.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration22_gallery_fb.py + test_facebook_crop.py. Run with `pytest -o addopts='' tests/test_iteration22_gallery_fb.py tests/test_facebook_crop.py` (xdist causes ordering issues for E2E test). Facebook token is scope-blocked (pages_manage_posts missing) — this is intentional per user pending action, tests already assert that state. Once scope is granted, the E2E test's fb.ok=False assertion will need to be updated to allow ok=True. /admin/manage?tab=gallery — approved tab currently has 8 items (4 failed + 4 not-attempted badges). Repost button works and updates facebook_attempted_at.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Facebook errors are expected/intentional due to missing scope on the FB Page token; owner action pending outside this test scope.
